Description:
The Cunning Guest - 简体中文汉化 (Simplified Chinese Translation)

This is a Simplified Chinese translation for the mod **The Cunning Guest by the original author. 
这是一个由原作者授权的《The Cunning Guest》简体中文汉化补丁。

---

鸣谢 (Credits)
 Huge thanks to the original author for creating this amazing mod!
特别感谢原作者带来的优秀 Mod！

---

安装说明 (Installation)
1. Make sure you have downloaded and installed the original mod 
   请确保您已经下载并安装了原版 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54216]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54216[/url]
2. Extract the downloaded translation file.
   解压下载的汉化压缩包。
3. Place the `zh.json` file into the mod's folder: 
   `[CP] The Cunning Guest/i18n/`
   将 `zh.json` 文件放入模组目录下的 `i18n` 文件夹中。

---

注意事项 (Notes)
* This file only contains the translation (`zh.json`). You still need the main mod to make it work.
* 本文件仅包含汉化文本（`zh.json`），使用前必须先安装原 Mod 主程序。
